title: Backups
sub: Every night the server copies the shop to its own disk, to Azure Blob and to your Google Drive, then checks every copy.

kpi.testSub: a backup restored into a test database

safe.title: Three copies, in three places.
safe.text: The server keeps the newest days on its own disk; Blob and Drive keep copies away from the server. The Drive copies are locked with a key only the shop's vault holds.

drive.title: Your Google Drive
drive.desc: One click: the shop asks Google for access to its own backup folder only (drive.file). It never sees your other files.
drive.clientHelp: Once only, in your own Google Cloud (never the ERP's project): a project with the Google Drive API on; the OAuth consent screen External with the scope drive.file, and published ("In production" — in "Testing" Google ends the connection after 7 days); then Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID → type "TVs and Limited Input devices". Paste its client ID and secret here. No redirect address is needed.
drive.clientSecretHint: kept only in the vault; never shown again
drive.clientSaved: The client is saved. Now press Connect Google Drive.
drive.codeHelp: Open the Google page on a phone or computer, sign in with the Google account the backups should go to, type the code and press Allow.
drive.waiting: Waiting for you to press Allow at Google…
drive.denied: Google says Allow was not pressed. Press Connect Google Drive to try again.
drive.expired: The code expired. Press Connect Google Drive for a new one.
drive.none: No sign-in is waiting. Press Connect Google Drive.
drive.connectedNow: Google Drive is connected. Tonight's backup goes to the folder "{folder}".
drive.keeps: Drive keeps the newest {n} checked copies
drive.keepsDays: Drive keeps copies by days (the number of copies is 0)
drive.disconnectWarn: After this, no backup goes to Drive until you connect again. The copies already in Drive stay there.
drive.changeWarn: Changing the client ends the Drive connection, and backups are less safe until you connect Drive again with the new one. Only do this if the old client was deleted.
drive.readOnly: You can see this page. Connecting and disconnecting needs the "Keys" permission.

list.title: Backups in your Drive
list.sub: Newest first. "Checked" means the server compared every file after the upload.
list.none: No backup in Drive yet. The first one goes there tonight.
list.practice: Practice Drive — nothing went to Google

blob.title: Azure Blob
blob.desc: The second copy away from the server. Its keys are in Keys & connections (Azure Blob).

server.title: Last nightly runs
server.sub: What the server wrote after its last runs.
server.none: The server has not reported yet (normal on a new installation).

backups.NOT_CONNECTED: Google Drive is not connected, or Google ended the access. Press Connect Google Drive.
backups.NO_SIGN_IN: No sign-in is waiting. Press Connect Google Drive.

errors.PIN_LOCKED: Too many wrong PINs. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.PIN_NOT_SET: The owner has not set a books PIN yet (Money → Books).
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have the permission for this.
errors.VAULT_NOT_CONFIGURED: The vault is not set up on this server yet.
errors.server-error: Something went wrong on the server; please try again shortly.
errors.network: Could not reach the server — check the connection and try again.

alerts.clientChanged: {store}: the Google client was changed — no backup goes to Google Drive until it is connected again.
alerts.connected: {store}: Google Drive is connected ({account}) — the nightly backup now goes to the folder "{folder}".
alerts.disconnected: {store}: the Google Drive connection was ended — no backup goes to Drive until it is connected again.
